title: Preloader that hands off to the hero through an opening aperture
summary: Curtain gated on fonts + the hero's first frame (4 s ceiling, no floor, head-script `is-gated` so neither the hero nor the curtain flashes), lifted `yPercent −100` while the hero opens from `clip-path: inset(30% round 12px)` to `inset(0% round 0px)` and its media scales `.6 → 1` (1.4 s `expo.inOut`); root `overflow: hidden` + `inert` until open, `__awards.ready` after the hand-off, `sessionStorage` repeat-visit skip, Skip button; a curtain fade only under reduced motion, a cut in the static tier
variants: curtain lifts while the hero opens from a rounded clip-path inset and its media scales in (this, default)
intro film sized to the live element's rect and cut onto it on its last frame, with a timer fallback
curtain with a bowed lower edge (two-step SVG path morph) for weight without a shader
